title: A Space with no street address is published as a LocalBusiness

source.ref: SEO, GEO and speed deep scan 2026-11-19 (production crawl of 3,000 URLs, all 720 sitemap pages, 8 crawler user agents, Lighthouse on 14 templates)

detail: 141 Space pages publish LocalBusiness with no address, and none of the 352 Space nodes carries geo or opening hours. Google ignores a LocalBusiness without an address, and answer engines read it as a place that cannot be found. Wanted: a business Space with no address is published as Organization, and LocalBusiness is kept for a Space that has one. A test (lib/jsonld.test.ts, the business Space case) pins business to LocalBusiness today, so the change needs the owner's own go-ahead for that pin. OWNER RULING 2026-11-19 (decision card): leave it as a local business. Not to be changed or raised again without a new ask from the owner.

verify.evidence: Production crawl, 2026-11-19: 141 of 352 Space JSON-LD nodes were LocalBusiness with no address; 0 had geo or openingHours; 222 had no telephone.
